text:
nora: Heads-up from Kronos: they'd like a quick joint perf/W sprint next Fri. Scope: Redwood runtime vs Kronos kernel-tune on 8x A100-80GB. Primary ask: tokens/joule and stable p99 for chat. Can we support?

ivan: Yes. I'd like kernel commit and any LD_PRELOAD libs. Propose power caps: 230W, 300W, and no-cap. Also want cold vs warm KV phases.

sam: I'll own telemetry. Plan: IPMI system power + NVML per-GPU at 1s. Will sync via monotonic clock and produce per-run joules.

jules: Kronos (jules) here. We'll provide kernel tag kronos/tune@9f4e and a container with kronos-tune.so. We can join the window and share diffs.

mira: Marketing requests: tok/s (mean + 99% CI), tok/joule, p95/p99, and a small quality sanity check. Need preliminary numbers within 48h of run.

ivan: Bench profile: chat mix [1,2,4], completion [8,16]. Repeat each config 4 times for CI. Warm phase = prefill 2k tokens. CSV schema: run_id, partner, build_tag, phase, batch, seq_len, tokens, seconds, joules, tok_per_joule, tok_per_sec, p95_ms, p99_ms, ci_tok_per_sec, notes.

bench-bot: Scheduled -> run_id=kronos-2026-04-12-a ; command: 
```
bench run --target a100-8x --model redwood-7b --profile chat:[1,2,4],completion:[8,16] --warmup 300 --repeats 4 --power-caps 230,300,0 --energy ipmi,nvml --report csv --eval sanity-40
```

mira: Legal reminder: avoid absolute "X% faster" headlines until verified. Also store raw outputs and logs for 90 days.

jules: We'll DM the BMC creds for the window and confirm the tuned build container. Expect subtle memcpy scheduling changes.

sam: Ack. I'll push the telemetry harness and CI bootstrap today.

ivan: Ack. I'll prepare perf counters to collect: sm_eff, dram_util, l2_hit.

nora: Great. Please ack if you can take the slot so I can lock lab time and loop in kronos. :thumbsup:

ivan: Ack.

sam: Ack.

mira: Ack. I'll prep the announcement template.

jules: Ack from Kronos side. We'll be available on the run day.
